_about: Public-domain John Gilmary Shea (1824-1892, father of American Catholic history) for the Word Hoard: A History of the Catholic Church within the Limits of the United States (4 vols, 1886-1892, vol. 2 being the Life and Times of John Carroll) and the History of the Catholic Missions among the Indian Tribes of the United States (1855), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 33 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

shea-catholic-church-us-1: The Catholic Church in Colonial Days, 1521-1763 (History of the Catholic Church in the United States, vol. 1) (New York: John G. Shea, 1886)
shea-catholic-church-us-2: Life and Times of the Most Rev. John Carroll, 1763-1815 (vol. 2) (New York: John G. Shea, 1888)
shea-catholic-church-us-3: A History of the Catholic Church within the Limits of the United States, 1808-1843 (vol. 3) (New York: John G. Shea, 1890)
shea-catholic-church-us-4: A History of the Catholic Church within the Limits of the United States, 1843-1866 (vol. 4) (New York: John G. Shea, 1892)
shea-indian-missions: History of the Catholic Missions among the Indian Tribes of the United States, 1529-1854 (New York: Edward Dunigan, 1855)

_alternates.shea-copies: Other copies of the four volumes, some catalogued 1886 in error; the 1855 Missions in other copies

_excluded.shea-kenedy: Undated Kenedy reissues of the Missions catalogued 1854
